summary: Repaired `/srv/inventory` and verified the repair persists after reboot. Existing contents and checksums were preserved; RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created the missing system group `inventory-readers` and system account `inventorysvc`.
Set directories to 0750 and files to 0640.
Verified reader-group access and denial for unrelated users.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified recovery under a changed boot ID.

evidence.summary: All directories are 0750, files are 0640, ownership is inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and no other-user permission bits exist.
Reader-group traversal/read succeeded for every file; an unrelated user was denied.
The original file list and SHA-256 checksums match before repair, after repair, and after reboot.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 0571f4dd-60b7-4601-9295-e4eebe622784, received reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 04897dad-0be2-4b04-a842-7f4af6093e92, and verified sshd, identities, permissions, data checksums, and access controls recovered.
